site_representation.aggregation: median per site and temporal split

metrics.spearman_rho: rank consistency of site median fingerprints
metrics.site_shift_normalized: absolute same-site median shift divided by robust pooled site-median scale
metrics.identity_mrr: mean reciprocal rank of the same site when retrieving target-period site medians
metrics.identity_top1_top5: same-site retrieval accuracy using single-feature median fingerprints
metrics.drift_to_separation: same-site temporal distance divided by median distance to other sites

ranking.score: mean percentile of worst Spearman, worst MRR, inverse P90 normalized same-site shift, and inverse P90 drift/separation
